heading: What SR.Automates builds for you
intro: Four kinds of work, usually combined. Tell me the problem and I'll tell you what it actually needs. Free first look, no pressure.

items.name: Web & app development
items.description: Business websites, dashboards, portals and mobile-ready apps, designed, built and deployed as a finished product you can actually run.

items.name: Automation & custom tools
items.description: Scripts and internal tools that take over the reporting, data entry and monitoring your team shouldn't be doing by hand. Hours back, every week.

items.name: APIs & integrations
items.description: Connecting the systems you already pay for (databases, spreadsheets, sensors, third-party services) so data moves between them without a human in the middle.

items.name: IoT & embedded systems
items.description: Sensor-driven monitoring and control hardware, from a working prototype to a device that survives the field, with the dashboard to read it.

steps.title: Free first look
steps.text: Send me the problem. I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right fit and what it would take, at no cost.

steps.title: Scope and quote
steps.text: A clear written scope: what gets built, what it costs, and when it lands. No moving targets.

steps.title: Build in the open
steps.text: Regular working demos as it comes together, so you steer the build instead of waiting for a reveal.

steps.title: Launch and support
steps.text: Deployment, a full handover walkthrough, and a window of free fixes after go-live.
